;Business and economy
*[[2019 Japan–South Korea trade dispute]]
**[[South Korea]] officially removes Japan from its "whitelist" of countries with fast-track trade status. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-southkorea-japan-whitelist/south-korea-removes-japan-from-fast-track-trade-white-list-idUSKBN1W21T2 (Reuters)]
;Disasters and accidents
*At least 27 people, a majority of them children, are killed in a fire caused by an electrical problem at a boarding school in a suburb near the [[Liberia]]n capital of [[Monrovia]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-49743937 (BBC News)]
*A [[Twin Otter]] cargo plane carrying rice and four people goes missing shortly after its departure from [[Timika]], [[Indonesia]]. [https://theloadstar.com/cargo-plane-carrying-four-missing-in-eastern-indonesia/ (The Loadstar)]
;International relations
*[[Solomon Islands–United States relations]]
**[[Vice President of the United States|U.S. Vice President]] [[Mike Pence]] cancels a meeting with [[Solomon Islands]] [[Prime Minister of Solomon Islands|Prime Minister]] [[Manasseh Sogavare]] in response to the country's move to cut ties with [[Taiwan]] and establish relations with [[China]]. [https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/399067/us-vp-pence-calls-off-meeting-with-solomons-leader (RNZ)]
*[[Saudi Arabia]] joins the [[International Maritime Security Construct]]. [https://www.arabnews.com/node/1556046/saudi-arabia (''Arab News'')]

;Law and crime
*[[2019 Samoa assassination plot]]
**Prosecutiors in the case of the latest attempt to kill [[Prime Minister of Samoa|Samoan Prime Minister]] [[Tuilaʻepa Saʻilele Malielegaoi|Tuilaepa Sailele Malielegaoi]] announce that [[Eletise Leafa Vitale]], convicted of the assassination of one of Malielegoai's cabinet members in another failed attempt at killing him in 1999, will testify in the trial against the conspirators of this year's plot. [https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/398999/convicted-murderer-to-be-witness-in-samoan-assassination-case (RNZ)]
*[[Crisis in Venezuela]]
**The [[NGO]] [[Human Rights Watch]] publishes details of what it deems to be arbitrary executions and arrests in Venezuela. The Venezuelan government alleges that most of those listed in the report were armed criminals, but admits to have placed several hundred security agents under investigation for abuses of power and extrajudicial actions. [https://www.hrw.org/news/2019/09/18/venezuela-extrajudicial-killings-poor-areas (Human Rights Watch)]
*[[Murder of Derk Wiersum]]
**[[Dutch people|Dutch]] [[lawyer]] Derk Wiersum has been shot to death near his home. At the time of his death he was the lawyer of [[Turn state's evidence|state witness]] Nabil Bakkali in the [[:Nl:Marengo-proces|Marengo-proces]] against the Mocro Maffia led by Ridouan Taghi. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-49740366 (BBC News)]

O'Brien]] as his new [[National Security Advisor (United States)|National Security Advisor]].
